notes.frame: Area 2 shares area 1's frame (centre (-470, -293)); the doors line up in plan, instant warps add only the vertical offset between area 1's flattened grade and the real level (+6 north entrance, -2 South Terrace, +4 Level 1 south exit, 0 Ground north door).
notes.floor_height: Floors 6.0 m apart (real ~4.5 m), 5.4 m clear; the tower floors (L4-L6) 5.0 m apart (real ~3.2 m hotel floors), 4.4 m clear. Plans 1:1 (the registered wayfinding geometry).
notes.grand_ballroom: Double height: L2 floor to the L3 roof line, 11.4 m clear (real ~7 m, estimated from photos).
notes.rion_ballroom: Top floor, so its ceiling rises 0.6 m above the L3 corridor ceiling (6.0 m clear; the photo reads about 5 m).
notes.meeting_rooms: Ground (G310-G330, the Senate Chamber), L2 and L3 meeting rooms have a dropped lay-in ceiling at 3.9 m (photos ~2.7-3 m), raised for the camera.
notes.stair_halls: The enclosed stair halls are not built (closed doors, sealed shafts; no photos): floors connect by the Blue elevator pads and the atrium scissor stairs.
notes.atrium: Ground to a cedar ceiling at 25.6 m over the voids (L3 ceiling + a 2.2 m clerestory band).
notes.sealed: Offices, restrooms, kitchens, back-of-house rooms, the stair shafts and most hotel rooms are closed doors (no photos; not public). Open: corridors, the atrium, vestibules, every meeting room, the ballrooms, the Auditorium, the Gallery, the Senate Chamber, the Game Room, the Gator Esports Center, Orange & Brew, the Arts & Crafts Center and the dance studios, the Level 4 event rooms, hotel rooms 516 and 501/502 and a balcony.
notes.elevators: The Blue elevators (the only bank that reaches the hotel) are vanilla teleport pads: two open cars per floor (north-west UP, north-east DOWN). The Orange and service elevators are closed.
notes.brands: Food court storefronts: the vendors' plain names in the colours of the user's photos (STARBUCKS, PANDA, BABA'S PIZZA, HALAL SHACK, HOME OF THE GATORS / BOOKSTORE) with simple generic round badges; no reproduced logo artwork (no siren, swoosh or panda mark). Older slots keep generic signs.
notes.inferred: No public photo of: the hotel reception, the Info Desk, Orange & Brew, Subway / The Market, the stairwells, restrooms, hotel corridors. Those are drawn plainly (the plan + the house finishes).
